verdict.rationale: AMD documents a serving stack story for RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) via ROCm docs: vLLM full support, llama.cpp supported, SGLang supported, PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX/ONNX on Linux/Windows, plus Docker-based setup. However, no TensorRT-LLM support (NVIDIA-specific, not applicable) and no explicit documentation of FP8/FP4 low-precision inference formats for this specific consumer part. missing for 10: FP8/FP4 quantization support documentation for RX 9070 XT, independent/hands-on benchmarks confirming these serving stacks work well on this consumer GPU.
